description: This file implements a PHP class 'ADODB_pdo_pgsql' which provides database abstraction for PostgreSQL using PDO in PHP. It contains methods for retrieving database information, querying metadata, handling transactions, and executing SQL commands specifically tailored for PostgreSQL.
external_files: ADODB" (implied dependency, likely part of the ADOdb library, and possibly other PHP PDO and database-related classes)

classes.name: ADODB_pdo_pgsql
classes.description: A PHP class that extends ADODB_pdo to handle PostgreSQL-specific database operations via PDO, including metadata retrieval, transaction management, and SQL query customization.

methods.name: ServerInfo
methods.description: Retrieves the server version information by executing 'select version()' on the PostgreSQL server and parsing the version number.

methods.name: SelectLimit
methods.description: Executes an SQL query with optional limits and offsets, supporting caching if needed.

methods.name: MetaTables
methods.description: Retrieves a list of tables and views from the PostgreSQL database, optionally filtered by a mask.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Fetches metadata about columns of a specified table, including types, lengths, defaults, and key information.

methods.name: BeginTrans
methods.description: Starts a database transaction if supported.

methods.name: CommitTrans
methods.description: Commits the current database transaction if active.

methods.name: RollbackTrans
methods.description: Rolls back the current database transaction if active.

methods.name: SetTransactionMode
methods.description: Sets the transaction isolation mode for subsequent database operations.

methods.name: param
methods.description: Returns a driver-specific string for a bound parameter, using colon-prefixed notation.
